annotations.title: Remove a connection between two pages

description: Deletes one edge from the graph (the pages stay). Use only when a connection was never true — the system isn't used by that workflow, it was recorded by mistake. When a relationship WAS true and has stopped (the person left the team, moved roles), end it with compass_links_update `validTo` instead, so the history stays. Link ids come from compass_page_links_list. Re-creating the same edge later revives it. May return `needs_confirmation`.

approvalId.description: Approval id from a prior needs_confirmation response, after the user has approved. Omit on the first call.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.

name: compass_links_delete
title: Remove a connection between two pages
